Specification: This module models an early, now-outdated version of the Nano blockchain protocol. It represents signed blocks, account chains, balances, and per-node ledgers, along with actions for creating and processing genesis, open, send, receive, and change-representative blocks. The specification assumes abstract cryptographic primitives for hashing and signatures, models a distributed setting where each node maintains its own ledger and a set of received-but-unprocessed blocks, and verifies a safety theorem showing that the temporal specification implies the type invariant and a cryptographic safety invariant.
AssumptionNames:
/\ \A data, oldHash, newHash :
        /\ CalculateHash(data, oldHash, newHash) \in BOOLEAN
    /\ KeyPair \in [PrivateKey -> PublicKey]
    /\ GenesisBalance \in Nat
    /\ Ownership \in [Node -> PrivateKey]
IfThenElse:
IF S = {}
    THEN 0
    ELSE
        LET e == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN
        e + SumBag(B (-) SetToBag({e}))
CaseExpr:
CASE block.type = "open" -> ValueOfSendBlock(ledger, block.source)
    [] block.type = "send" -> block.balance
    [] block.type = "receive" ->
        BalanceAt(ledger, block.previous)
        + ValueOfSendBlock(ledger, block.source)
    [] block.type = "change" -> BalanceAt(ledger, block.previous)
    [] block.type = "genesis" -> block.balance
RecordConstructor:
[previous   : Hash,
    balance     : AccountBalance,
    destination : PublicKey,
    type        : {"send"}]

[account    : PublicKey,
    source      : Hash,
    rep         : PublicKey,
    type        : {"open"}]

[account    |-> publicKey,
                source      |-> srcHash,
                rep         |-> repPublicKey,
                type        |-> "open"]

[previous   |-> prevHash,
                    balance     |-> newBalance,
                    destination |-> recipient,
                    type        |-> "send"]
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE hash \in Hash :
        LET signedBlock == ledger[hash] IN
        /\ signedBlock /= NoBlock
        /\ PublicKeyOf(ledger, hash) = publicKey
        /\ ~\E otherHash \in Hash :
            LET otherSignedBlock == ledger[otherHash] IN
            /\ otherSignedBlock /= NoBlock
            /\ otherSignedBlock.block.type \in {"send", "receive", "change"}
            /\ otherSignedBlock.block.previous = hash
